tipsCenter.historyZeroSome: {{zero}} of {{total}} tips have 0 unlock Units and count as €0 in the model. ROI uses only the other {{positive}} tips with a positive stake weight; hit rate includes all {{total}} results.
tipsCenter.detailIntro: Each selected tip is shown with original odds, required Units, simulated stake and net result. Amounts use the euro slider above and are calculated only when opened.
tipsCenter.detailFoot: When viewing “Overall”, up to ten tips appear per page. The overall totals above still include every selected tip. Historical 0-Unit tips count as €0 in the model.
tipsCenter.modelIntro: Calculated overall result for the selected group, excluding unlock costs. Past performance does not guarantee future profits.
tipsCenter.roiIntro: Each published tip is weighted by the BetInsight Units originally required to unlock it. Hypothetical stake = required Units × selected euros per Unit (€1–€100). Profit or loss uses the original odds for that tip.
tipsCenter.roiMethod: The selected group (1–10, 11–20 or Overall) combines total stakes, payouts and net profit/loss. Betting ROI = total simulated net profit/loss ÷ total simulated stakes × 100. Units act only as stake weights and are not deducted again as unlock costs.
tipsCenter.roiExample: Example: 5 required Units at €10 each and odds of 2.30 mean a €50 simulated stake. Win: €115 payout and €65 net profit; loss: €50 lost. Since Units and odds differ per tip, weighted ROI differs from equal stakes. The euro slider changes totals but not the ROI percentage. Historical 0-Unit tips count as €0 stake, but still affect hit rate.
tipsCenter.roiDisclaimer: These figures describe past results. They are neither a staking recommendation nor a profit guarantee.
tipsCenter.roiExtra: A tip is missing valid odds or Units, or the group has no positive modeled stake. ROI cannot be shown accurately.
